# East Yorkshire Renovations

> East Yorkshire Renovations is a renovation and damp-proofing firm based on Station Road, Hessle, HU13 0BG, covering Hull, East Yorkshire and North Lincolnshire. It does damp surveys and damp treatment, kitchens, bathrooms, full house renovations and larger home improvements, and does its own plastering, making good and decorating.

## Key facts

- Business: East Yorkshire Renovations (legal name East Yorkshire Renovation), trading since 2025
- Address: Station Road, Hessle, HU13 0BG
- Phone: 07498 951487
- Email: info@eastyorkshirerenovation.com
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:30 (closed weekends)
- Damp survey: £119 including VAT, deducted from the cost of treatment if you go ahead with the quote
- Landlord damp and mould report: £99 including VAT
- Pre-purchase damp report: written report within 3 days
- Damp-proofing guarantees: written guarantees of up to 30 years, depending on the treatment (30 years on a damp-proof course injection)
- Insurance: £2,000,000 public liability
- Areas covered: Hull, Beverley, Hessle, Cottingham, Anlaby, East Riding of Yorkshire, Willerby, Kirk Ella, Swanland, Brough, North Ferriby, Walkington, Hornsea, Driffield, Bridlington, Goole, Scunthorpe, Brigg, Barton-upon-Humber, North Lincolnshire, Grimsby
- Google Business Profile and reviews: https://g.page/r/CaA4QBPRUpb2EBM
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594987884780
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/east_yorkshire_renovation/

- [Damp proofing hub](https://www.eastyorkshirerenovation.com/damp-proofing/): survey first, then treatment, replastering and guarantee

- [Pre-purchase damp surveys](https://www.eastyorkshirerenovation.com/damp-proofing/pre-purchase-damp-survey/): for buyers whose mortgage survey says damp noted
